name: Muñopedro (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Muñopedro (a chapel on yellow, the aqueduct on red and a tower on blue).
history: Muñopedro adopted its arms and flag officially on 22 December 1997, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 17 January 1998; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, tierced per pale of blue, yellow and red, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Muñopedro arms — chapel on yellow, the aqueduct on red and tower on blue
